description: Create a structured snippet asset (a header like "Services" or "Types" + up to 10 values) and attach it to a campaign. Refs #5764.

campaignId.description: Campaign to attach the snippet to.

customerId.description: Google Ads customer ID. Defaults to GOOGLE_ADS_CUSTOMER_ID env var.

header.description: Snippet header (must be a valid Google header, e.g. "Types", "Services", "Brands", "Features").

name: gads_add_structured_snippet
